unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U14: Distinguish interim asset protection, adjudication and recovery certificate

facts.statement: Conditional attachments need statutory obstruction/security/showcause basis;receiver powers distinct;hear claims/setoff/counterclaim;final order/certificate issued byPO;certificate sentRO;electronic filing subject19A rules;target180days not proven actualdisposal.

payload.title: An interim order preserves the process; it does not replace the final decision
payload.core_explanation_md:
The source provides interim tools where the statutory conditions are established, including the described security direction, attachment and receiver arrangements. An attachment should not be treated as automatic merely because a recovery application was filed. The required grounds, property particulars and opportunity must be addressed.

The final determination considers the claims, set-off, counterclaim and hearing record. The Presiding Officer then issues the stated certificate for the Recovery Officer to execute. Electronic filing under section 19A still needs the applicable form and authentication. A statutory disposal target is a planning standard, not evidence that an actual case was decided on that date.

self_check.prompt_text: Does an interim attachment prove the final debt amount?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Asset preservation and final adjudication are different stages.

payload.stem_md: A lender describes an interim attachment as a final certificate for the full claimed debt. What is the correct distinction?

options.text_md: The interim measure preserves assets while the final claim still needs determination
options.explanation_md: Attachment is not itself the final debt adjudication.

options.text_md: Every interim measure conclusively admits every pleading
options.explanation_md: The merits remain subject to the legal process.

options.text_md: The Recovery Officer can issue the original merits judgment privately
options.explanation_md: The offices have distinct statutory functions.

options.text_md: A hearing target proves the case has already been disposed of
options.explanation_md: A target is not an observed order.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Attachment is not itself the final debt adjudication.

payload.stem_md: An electronic upload is assumed valid despite missing the prescribed authentication. Which check is required?

options.text_md: Only whether the file extension is PDF
options.explanation_md: File type alone does not satisfy statutory authentication.

options.text_md: Whether the document has colourful headings
options.explanation_md: Visual style does not establish a valid filing.

options.text_md: The applicable electronic form, authentication and filing rules
options.explanation_md: The legal filing requirements remain relevant in electronic form.

options.text_md: Whether the borrower has downloaded the bank app
options.explanation_md: App use does not determine Tribunal authentication.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The legal filing requirements remain relevant in electronic form.
